1. Case overview

Summary. 8 plans were evaluated: 7 NeoArc (DMAT) variants and 1 reference plan.

Clinical background and rationale. Anal-canal targets prescribed 50.4 and 45.08 Gy in 28 fractions. The lower dose is reported as saved, despite the 4500 structure labels. The comparison examines coverage at both dose levels alongside bowel-loop, bladder and genital dose.

Plan generation. NeoArc (DMAT) plan generated for: Accela. NeoArc (DMAT): 8FFF; 2 arcs; modulation −3, −2, −1, 0, +1, +2, +3. Reference setup: VMAT — 10 MV, 2 arcs.

Goal setup. The NeoArc (DMAT) source reports contained 18 provided goals per plan, with priority identifiers, goal thresholds and acceptable-variation fields. Derived and automatic objectives were listed separately. For DA248, examples were PTV_4500 V45.00 Gy ≥ 95.0 % (P1.7); GENITALIA_EXT V40.00 Gy ≤ 0.0 % (P1.1).

Comparison methods. Dose colorwash, DVHs, individual endpoint–time plots and the saved 17-endpoint scorecard were compared. All saved dose factors were 1.0; no additional rescaling was applied. Scores summarize the selected endpoints. NeoArc (DMAT) timing came from matched metrics; reference timing used user-entered delivery time.

2. Dose colorwash

Compare target coverage and dose spread at the same slice. Slice positions are synchronized across plans.

Scroll over a dose image to change slices. Use the slider or arrow keys as an alternative. Dragging is disabled.

Dose viewer loads when visible.
15 GySIB 45.1 GySIB 50.4 Gy54 Gy

Colorwash sampling details

Every dose is evaluated on DA240’s patient-coordinate dose grid before CT slices are sampled every 5 mm from its isocenter. Native grids that differ are trilinearly resampled. The in-plane display and superior–inferior slice range are restricted to the selected reference plan’s 40% prescription-dose bounding volume plus 50 mm in every direction; CT slices outside that range are not embedded. Each colorwash has a slim slice slider beneath it; moving any slider advances every plan synchronously. The compact zoom buttons, pointer drag, and reset remain synchronized and persist while changing slices. Mouse-wheel scrolling continues to move the report page. All plans use the confirmed 15–54 Gy color scale.
